findings.detail: The exact 300-second Balance calibration completed with accepted capture, comparable reference setup, zero deaths, and verified cleanup.
Spell 24907 was active on the owner for all observed samples with amount 5, effect mask 1, and owner caster GUID 30540.
The scoring-start spell-speed multiplier remained 1.269, below the pinned WoWSims value 1.332199768447153; the 5% 24907 modifier is not reflected in the effective result.
Balance DPS comparison remains inadmissible until native effective-stat parity is repaired; no actor or raid performance requirement is accepted.
